<!-- Generated by cargo xtask guide-check --write-reference. Do not edit. -->

Every menu and menu entry, in the order the app shows them.

| Label | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| {{ui:menu.file}} | Start, open, save, export and share this design. |
| {{ui:menu.file.new}} | Start a fresh empty design. |
| {{ui:menu.file.open}} | Choose a design to open; your recent designs are listed on the screen that appears. |
| {{ui:menu.file.save}} | Write the design to its file on disk. Ctrl+S does the same. |
| {{ui:menu.file.export}} | Write the board out so other design tools can open it. |
| {{ui:menu.file.copy_picture}} | Copy a PNG snapshot of the current view so it can be pasted into a document. |
| {{ui:menu.edit}} | Step back and forward, copy and paste, sync the board, and start the wiring over on one connection or the whole board. |
| {{ui:menu.edit.undo}} | Step back one action; every edit here is one undoable step. Ctrl+Z does the same. |
| {{ui:menu.edit.copy}} | Copy the selected objects as text; paste them here or in another window. |
| {{ui:menu.edit.paste}} | Paste the last copy a little to the side, with new reference numbers. |
| {{ui:menu.edit.cleanup}} | Remove zero-length and dangling pieces and join straight neighbours. One undo puts it all back. |
| {{ui:menu.edit.redo}} | Step forward to the action you undid. Ctrl+Shift+Z or Ctrl+Y does the same. |
| {{ui:menu.edit.sync}} | Copy every symbol, wire and net onto the board, then show the board. |
| {{ui:menu.edit.clear_net}} | Lift every piece of copper drawn for the lit connection. The connection itself stays. |
| {{ui:menu.edit.clear_all}} | Start the copper over on the whole board. Parts, connections and copper zones stay. |
| {{ui:menu.settings}} | Theme, grid, language and library folders. |
| {{ui:menu.settings.appearance}} | Open the settings page: theme, accent colour and everything for the project. |
| {{ui:menu.settings.theme_light}} |  |
| {{ui:menu.settings.theme_dark}} |  |
| {{ui:menu.settings.grid_hide}} |  |
| {{ui:menu.settings.grid_show}} |  |
| {{ui:menu.settings.route_on}} | Choose which copper layer new tracks are drawn on. |
| {{ui:menu.settings.route_top}} |  |
| {{ui:menu.settings.route_bottom}} |  |
| {{ui:menu.settings.pad_labels}} | Pick what sits at each pad centre on the board: its number, its net, or nothing. |
| {{ui:menu.settings.library_sources}} | Manage the folders that feed the component list. |
| {{ui:menu.settings.language}} | Choose the language of menus and messages. The change applies at once. |
| {{ui:menu.settings.language.system}} | Follow the language of this computer. |
| {{ui:menu.help}} | Shortcuts, the command search and bug reports. |
| {{ui:menu.help.shortcuts}} | Show every keyboard shortcut and mouse gesture in one list. |
| {{ui:menu.help.commands}} | Search every command by name and run it, with its parameters explained. |
